title: Crushing chest pain at the dacha
presenting_complaint: Central crushing chest pain radiating to the jaw for 50 minutes, started while chopping wood, accompanied by sweating, nausea and one episode of vomiting.
history: Type 2 diabetes on metformin. Hypertension on ramipril. Smokes 20 cigarettes/day. No prior MI. No recent surgery or bleeding, no history of stroke.

findings.name: ECG
findings.value: ST elevation 3 mm in II, III and aVF with reciprocal ST depression in I and aVL; right-sided leads show ST elevation in V4R; sinus bradycardia

findings.name: Chest X-ray
findings.value: normal heart size, no pulmonary oedema

diagnosis_options.label: Acute inferior STEMI with right ventricular involvement
diagnosis_options.explanation: Correct diagnosis: inferior STEMI (ST elevation in II, III, aVF with reciprocal changes and right-sided V4R elevation) with right ventricular infarction.

diagnosis_options.label: NSTEMI
diagnosis_options.explanation: Partially right — acute MI but wrong type; the ECG shows STEMI, not NSTEMI.

diagnosis_options.label: Aortic dissection
diagnosis_options.explanation: Alternative diagnosis offered; not supported by the clinical picture and ECG findings.

diagnosis_options.label: Acute pericarditis
diagnosis_options.explanation: Alternative diagnosis offered; the regional ST elevation with reciprocal depression and troponin rise favour infarction, not pericarditis.

diagnosis_options.label: Pulmonary embolism
diagnosis_options.explanation: Alternative diagnosis offered; the ECG and clinical findings point to inferior STEMI, not pulmonary embolism.

management_options.label: Aspirin 300 mg loading
management_options.explanation: Essential: immediate antiplatelet therapy in suspected acute MI.

management_options.label: IV fluid bolus for hypotension (RV infarct is preload-dependent)
management_options.explanation: Essential: right ventricular infarction is preload-dependent, so fluid bolus is indicated for hypotension.

management_options.label: P2Y12 inhibitor loading (ticagrelor or clopidogrel)
management_options.explanation: Reasonable and indicated as part of dual antiplatelet therapy, but not the highest-priority action compared with aspirin and reperfusion.

management_options.label: Sublingual nitroglycerin
management_options.explanation: Harmful here: nitroglycerin precipitates profound hypotension in right ventricular infarction.

management_options.label: Morphine as first-line analgesia
management_options.explanation: Avoid/harmful: morphine can worsen hypotension in right ventricular infarction.
